usage.callShape: POST https://gg402.vercel.app/translate_text with JSON body {text, target_language}
usage.outputShape: Expected body.translatedText / body.translation, but endpoint returns body.status="ERROR" with body.error.message and body.error.code instead (server misconfigured).
quirks: BROKEN: backend returns HTTP 500 'GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY not configured. Please set GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY environment variable.' — the server is missing its upstream API key.
Pre-payment probe shows 402 (looks payable) but the endpoint charges then fails. Money is lost on every call.
Body {text, target_language} passed validation (got past input checks to the translate call), so the failure is purely server-side config, not body shape.
Do NOT call this endpoint — it charges $0.01 USDC and returns an error every time.
usage.guide: Do not call this endpoint. It is a charge-then-fail: a POST to https://gg402.vercel.app/translate_text with body {text, target_language} debits $0.01 USDC on Base and then returns HTTP 500 with body.error.message "GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY not configured" because the backend is missing its Google Translate upstream key. No translation is ever returned. Treat as dead until the provider fixes their server config.
